scope: Local course material describes TP1 and shared dataset columns, not an authoritative TP2 threat_rank definition

definitions.paraphrase: Anonymous unique identifier for vulnerability observations.
Disclosure-cycle order index; larger values indicate newer observation periods.
TP1 regression target described as a continuous-scale technical-impact index. Actual train has 80 rounded values; scale semantics and observed support are different concepts.
